top_stories.title: Nvidia snaps up Hugging Face for $12.9 billion as closed AI labs pull away
top_stories.summary: Nvidia is buying open-source AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, about 80 times its $150 million annual revenue. The deal fits Nvidia's push to invest billions in open AI models while closed providers like OpenAI and Anthropic move away from Nvidia hardware. top_stories.title: The UK Power Grid Has a Phantom Data Center Problem
top_stories.summary: The UK’s energy regulator is using a variety of tricks to keep speculative data center projects from plugging into the power grid. The country’s AI ambitions hang in the balance.
top_stories.technical_takeaway: Hardware and energy constraints now shape model design decisions.
